verdict.rationale: Flagsmith ships an official MCP Server that exposes the Admin/Management API to AI assistants and agents, which implies AI agents (e.g. Claude, Copilot) can execute flag/segment/environment operations via natural-language prompts through the assistant. A CLI is also documented, but neither the MCP docs nor CLI docs explicitly describe a natural-language command interface or give hands-on examples of NL-driven flag management. Missing for 10: explicit natural-language usage examples/demos, independent/hands-on confirmation that AI agents reliably operate Flagsmith via NL prompts rather than structured API calls.
